title: The Disputed Acoustic Ridge

features.name: disputed-echo-column
features.desc-on-touch: two voices arguing the same frequency; you hear them swap positions, as if each tries to prove it started first

features.name: ridge-that-heard-itself
features.desc-on-touch: stone that rings with its own topology; each outcrop a different pitch; you walk the ridge and the mountain sings itself out of tune

features.name: silence-monument
features.desc-on-touch: a carved stone post marking the exact frequency where argument becomes listening; silence was carved into granite

features.name: the-echo-lovers
features.desc-on-touch: two peaks that call to each other across the valley in voices the other can never quite match; they have been arguing for the shape of sound for centuries

features.name: argument-deepens-downward
features.desc-on-touch: the ridge fractures along its acoustic lines, and you hear how the earth itself stores the memory of what was shouted into it

inscription: here two echoes learned they could never agree on which was the original voice

file.name: Ridge_Acoustic_Argument_Spectrogram_Night.png
file.note: visual trace of the same 4-second phrase shouted from opposing peaks, frequencies drifting apart with each exchange

exits.label: the path downward to where stones stop arguing
the ridge continuing higher, where voices become thin and then disappear entirely
a descending slope that carries echoes eastward, toward a place that cannot be reached by walking
